headline: Protein language model embeddings paired with molecular graphs for activity prediction
label: Protein Language Model Integration
summary: October 2026 papers pair protein language model embeddings with graph and diffusion architectures for ligand, target and enzyme prediction.
synthesis: The common thread is conditioning molecular or sequence representations on protein language model outputs or protein structure features to predict ligand activity, binding, and functional properties. Examples include frozen protein language model embeddings fused with ligand graphs for GPCR activity, ProtT5/ESM-2 embeddings with LightGBM and a CT-Net for anti-inflammatory peptides, and Katalyst's contrastive alignment of enzyme sequences with protein text, substrates and products for kcat prediction. New elements are heterogeneous: a 93.5M-parameter graph Transformer pretrained on 1.54B ZINC20 molecules, conformal uncertainty intervals for drug-target affinity, and diffusion or decision-transformer generators conditioned on PROTAC linker properties, pocket conformations, or ESM3 target embeddings. An enzyme-substrate audit shows similarity-driven leakage inflates reported performance, and a GPCR preprint reports strong internal scores alongside external-domain concerns.
